en.answer:
Your opponent may choose which zone their monster will return to.

~~~

Similarly, if your opponent's monster is banished by any of the following effects, and then returns to the field, your opponent chooses which zone to place it in: <<18923>>'s ①st effect, <<18822>>'s ①st effect, <<18495>>'s ②nd effect, the effect granted by <<17161>>'s ②nd effect, <<16851>>'s ①st effect, <<15870>>'s ③rd effect, <<14447>>'s ②nd effect, <<14947>>'s ①st effect, <<14553>>'s ②nd effect, <<13560>>'s ①st effect, <<13504>>'s ②nd effect, <<12891>>'s ①st effect, <<12110>>'s ②nd monster effect, <<11632>>'s ③rd effect, <<12073>>'s ①st effect, <<11888>>'s ②nd effect, <<9729>>'s ②nd effect, <<8581>>, <<18319>>, <<18006>>'s ②nd effect, <<14692>>, <<8341>>, <<20245>>'s ①st or ②nd effect, <<18041>>'s ①st effect, <<19019>>, <<17479>>'s ②nd effect, <<17189>>, and <<11779>>'s ①st effect.
en.question:
I have resolved <<19188>>'s『banish both [targeted monsters] until the End Phase』effect, banishing my opponent's monster. During the End Phase, that banished monster returns to my opponent's Monster Zone.

Who chooses which zone it will be placed in?
en.title: If the effect of my <<19188>> banishes my opponent's monster until the End Phase, and that monster returns, who chooses which zone it returns to?
